newsitem.title: UK: UK's Majestic Wine floats at 160p per share.
newsitem.headline: UK's Majestic Wine floats at 160p per share.

text.p: British wine warehouse chain, Majestic WIne Plc, on Tuesday set a 160p price tag on its flotation on London's Alternative Investment Market, giving the retailers a capitalisation of 20.4 million stg.
Majestic, which sells wine by the case, from 59 warehouse style stores, will raise 4.4 million stg from the float, of which two million will go towards expanding the business.
A majority holding in the company is likely to remain with non-executive chairman John Apthorp.
